source_authority: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
text: PFRDA says an NPS or APY subscriber can lodge a grievance at Level 1 through the PFRDA Pension Sahayak Portal at https://pensionsahayak.pfrda.org.in. The portal assigns the grievance to the concerned intermediary or nodal office. Resolution remarks are sent by email and can also be viewed in the portal. A subscriber can raise or track the grievance by logging in with a mobile number or PRAN. If the subscriber is dissatisfied with the resolution, or the intermediary has not resolved the grievance within 30 days of filing, the complaint may be escalated to NPS Trust from the portal's track-grievance page by using the escalation option.
title: Grievance Redressal Mechanism under NPS and APY - PFRDA

source_authority: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
text: PFRDA states that if a complainant is dissatisfied with the Level 2 redressal, or receives no reply for more than 21 days at Level 2, the subscriber may approach the PFRDA Ombudsman using the prescribed circular, FAQ and appeal format for NPS and APY grievances. The page lists the Ombudsman at PFRDA, E-500, Fifth Floor, Tower E, World Trade Center, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi 110029, phone 011-4071 7900, and email ombudsman[at]pfrda[dot]org[dot]in. If dissatisfied with the Ombudsman's award or order, the subscriber may file a revision application with the Designated Member (Grievances), PFRDA, stating the grounds for revision and using the revised application format. The page further states that a subscriber dissatisfied with the Designated Member's order may approach the Securities Appellate Tribunal.
title: Grievance Redressal Mechanism under NPS and APY - PFRDA
